whatToWatch.text: That defense travels — Seattle allowed just 10 points in the opener and got home for 3 sacks. Arizona's front matched that with 3 sacks of their own, so expect a game where the pass rushers decide it.

Vegas sees a scrap: Seahawks favored by 3.5 on the road with the total at a tight 41.5. Both units have been stingy early (SEA 10 points allowed per game, ARI 14), so every drive that ends in points is going to feel enormous.

Health watch on both sides. Seattle has nobody ruled out but five questionable, including Cooper Kupp, Nick Emmanwori and Ty Okada. Arizona has one out, with Garrett Williams and Dadrion Taylor-Demerson atop their report — secondary availability could swing this one.

newsBlurb.text: Drew Lock takes the reins in Arizona with Sam Darnold sidelined, and nobody's sure whether the injury costs Seattle one week or three. Lock looked steady in relief against New England, where the defense flipped last year's Week 1 script and closed out a 13-10 comeback instead of coughing it up late. Now Mike Macdonald's group finds out if that formula travels on the road — and Terrion Arnold's new deal gives the secondary another piece to lean on.
